description: Image  name (ROI cutout stem with the `_ROI` suffix stripped)
Path to the ROI cutout that was processed, relative to the `segmented/` folder.

Processing outcome e.g. 'ok' (colour extracted successfully), 'no_pixels_after_threshold' (every pixel in the ROI was excluded by the HSB threshold), or 'unreadable' (the image file could not be opened)
